extension.news: v1.0.11: Adds shared install library (script.module.tony7bones) + one-shot Setup (optional video add-ons chained from the base setup)

extension.summary: Shared install library for the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons
extension.description: Internal Python library used by the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons. It is not runnable on its own and does not appear on the home screen; it provides the shared add-on install, dependency-resolution and Kodi-integration machinery the Setup add-ons depend on.
Installs repositories and add-ons for a personal Kodi build.
extension.news: Fix the one-shot: video add-ons now actually install when chosen. If you say Yes to "Also install Video Add-ons?" on a fresh box, Setup now fetches the Video Add-ons Setup first (it was being skipped silently when not already installed), shows the picker, and installs your chosen apps — POV, The Loop, Sports HD — in the same run. If it ever can't load, the summary says so instead of silently dropping it. One-shot setup: Setup can now also install the Video Add-ons in the same run. It asks up front (default No); if you say yes it shows the video picker before anything installs, then does the whole job unattended — base repos and apps plus the chosen video add-ons — with one combined summary and one restart. The shared install machinery now lives in a common library (script.module.tony7bones). (v1.0.23 trimmed the Estuary home menu to TV, Add-ons, Favourites, Weather. v1.0.22 added Kodi home + sources directories to File Manager. v1.0.21 skipped optional dependencies — no more pulling Google Drive / cloud resolvers you didn't ask for. v1.0.20 made Setup remove itself after a successful run.)

extension.summary: Apply tony7bones logo and breadcrumb fixes to Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: Replaces the MOD V2 logo with the standard Estuary wordmark (vendor_logo.png) and restores section labels in the top bar. Run this after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Safe to re-run — original files are backed up once and never overwritten.

extension.summary: Install video add-ons from the Tony.7.Bones repos
extension.description: Pick which video add-ons to install (POV, The Loop, Sports HD, Umbrella). Each is installed with its full dependency closure, resolved live from the repositories already on this box, then enabled so it works straight away. Run the main Tony.7.Bones Setup first so the source repositories are present.
extension.news: Now built on the shared Tony.7.Bones install library (script.module.tony7bones) — same behaviour, less duplicated code. The main Tony.7.Bones Setup can also run this picker as part of its one-shot setup. The Loop's Dailymotion stays installed-but-disabled (durable across Loop updates) so The Loop's dependency check is satisfied with no broken flag, then disabled so it never runs; only Dailymotion is disabled, The Loop / POV / Sports HD stay enabled and browse normally. Still stamps origins and skips optional dependencies (no Google Drive / cloud resolvers).
